title: State Splitting
definition: The architectural practice of breaking a monolithic global state object down into smaller, highly focused slices to improve performance and code organization.
simpleExplanation: Don't put `ui` state (like is the modal open) in the same slice as `data` state (like the list of users). If they are in the same slice, updating the modal might accidentally trigger components that are watching the user data.

basic: What RTK function makes State Splitting incredibly easy?
intermediate: Why does splitting state improve performance?

answers.question: Why improve performance?
answers.answer: Because components selecting from `state.auth` completely ignore any actions that modify `state.cart`. It naturally isolates re-rendering zones.
